shots.line: Under the northern lights, three Helsinki startups are growing their teams.
At Töölönlahdenkatu 2, Verda runs data centres and GPU hardware for training AI models.
Following a Series B round of USD 189 million, Verda is hiring data center technicians and operations staff.
On Henry Fordin katu 6, ReOrbit builds sovereign satellites and software, with open roles in avionics and mission operations.
At Albertinkatu 25, Basemark develops augmented reality software for automotive and defense, and seeks a defense sales director.
From cloud infrastructure to space and defense, these teams are recruiting across the city.
